## 2026-08-31 — Stage 1 merge instrumentation and quality gates

- **Goal:** Complete Stage 1 technical instrumentation, then implement the user-approved sequence of pausing simulation for core reading before any Stage 2 representative-condition checks.
- **Work performed:** Added four lane-specific E1 detectors around the freeway merge; parameterized paired `qMain` and `qRamp` command-line demand while retaining fixed technical `qUrban` and cross traffic; extended summaries with requested, planned, inserted, arrived, in-network, and not-inserted vehicles; added E1 flow, occupancy, speed, `nVehContrib`, and `nVehEntered` summaries; separated fixed-window detector-description, vehicle-outcome, and capacity-analysis eligibility; added overall and per-class end truncation and explicit no-clearance-period status; updated tests and technical documentation; and synchronized the dashboard, project state, decision record, README, and interim-preparation sequence.
- **Files changed:** `config/scenarios/minimal_uncontrolled/scenario.add.xml`, `config/scenarios/minimal_uncontrolled/README.md`, `src/scenarios/run_minimal_uncontrolled.py`, `tests/test_minimal_uncontrolled.py`, `dashboard/thesis-control-center/data/thesis-dashboard.json`, `dashboard/thesis-control-center/tests/rendered-html.test.mjs`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, `docs/WORKLOG.md`, and `README.md`.
- **Commands and verification:** Python compilation passed; nine unit and real headless integration tests passed; independent low, custom `qMain=1440/qRamp=480`, and stress runs completed with zero `netconvert` or SUMO warnings/errors, collisions, teleports, emergency-braking warnings, or route errors; a data analyst independently reconciled vehicle accounting, route and ID sets, E1 summaries, demand conversion, truncation, and eligibility gates against raw XML; a scientific reviewer approved narrow Stage 1 closure. The dashboard JSON parsed, the direct Vinext production build passed, four Node tests passed, and ESLint passed.
- **Outcome:** Success for Stage 1 technical infrastructure. Low and custom runs are eligible only for fixed-window detector description; vehicle outcomes are ineligible because of per-class end truncation. Stress is ineligible for both detector and vehicle interpretation because demand was not fully inserted. All runs remain ineligible for capacity analysis and are not thesis evidence.
- **Problems and limitations:** There is no independent post-demand clearance period. The 15% per-class truncation limit, E1 positions, and 30-second period remain technical placeholders. Whole-run detector averages cannot establish Breakdown or Capacity Drop. Automatic GUI screenshots remain black, so visual topology and detector placement have not been reliably verified.
- **Next step:** Pause simulation; complete the core SUMO measurement and traffic-flow literature gate; then decide an exploratory demand/measurement/clearance structure, E1 time-series interpretation, and a reliable manual visual check before Stage 2 begins.
